Name: Loudini
Author: pim
Description: A software output volume for audio interfaces that have no OS volume of their own (e.g. Focusrite Scarlett). Uses a driverless macOS 14.4+ audio tap — no Background Music, no driver, no admin.

Actions.Name: Volume Up
Actions.Tooltip: Raise the software output volume for every app.

Actions.Name: Volume Down
Actions.Tooltip: Lower the software output volume for every app.

Actions.Name: Mute
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle mute for the software output volume.
